name: rtl-pdf
description: Correctly shaped right-to-left PDFs for Arabic, Urdu and Persian text, and a checker for broken Arabic text.

interface.longDescription:
Arabic, Urdu and Persian only print correctly when letters are shaped and lines run right to left. RTL PDF lays the text out with a full typesetting engine (letter shaping and the Unicode bidirectional algorithm) and embeds open-licence fonts (Noto Naskh Arabic, Noto Nastaliq Urdu, Cairo, Tajawal), then returns a download link valid for 24 hours.

make_pdf_arabic: headings, paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, tables and bold text, written as light Markdown; A4, A5 and Letter; Arabic and English in one line with numbers, dates and phone numbers kept in order; optional 3 mm bleed with crop marks; optional PDF/A with PDF/UA export.

check_arabic_text: finds pre-shaped or reversed letters copied out of broken PDFs, Persian or Urdu letters mixed with Arabic ones, hidden direction marks and characters the fonts cannot print, and suggests a fixed text.

No AI is used inside the tools: they do not write, translate or change wording.
defaultPrompt: Make a PDF of this Arabic letter with page numbers
Turn this Urdu text into an A5 PDF in Nastaliq
Check this Persian text for broken letters

positive.description: Arabic invitation to PDF; letters joined, date and time in order.
positive.prompt:
Make a PDF of this Arabic invitation:
# دعوة

يسرنا دعوتكم لحضور حفل الافتتاح يوم الخميس 22 أكتوبر 2026 الساعة 7:30 مساء.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_pdf_arabic with the invitation text and returns a download link. The PDF shows joined Arabic letters, right-to-left lines, and 22, 2026 and 7:30 in the right order.

positive.description: Arabic request (in Arabic) for an A5 PDF; phone number not reversed.
positive.prompt:
حوّل هذا الخطاب إلى ملف PDF بمقاس A5:
السيد المحترم، نؤكد استلام طلبكم رقم 48213. للاستفسار: 0300-1234567
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_pdf_arabic with paper A5 and returns a link. The phone number prints as 0300-1234567, not 1234567-0300.

positive.description: Urdu text to a Nastaliq PDF.
positive.prompt:
Turn this Urdu leave application into a PDF in Nastaliq:
بخدمت جناب پرنسپل صاحب، مؤدبانہ گزارش ہے کہ مجھے 3 دن کی چھٹی درکار ہے۔
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_pdf_arabic (language ur or auto, font nastaliq or auto) and returns a link to a PDF set in Noto Nastaliq Urdu with correct Nastaliq joins.

positive.description: Persian price list as a right-to-left table.
positive.prompt:
Make a printable Persian price list from this table:
| کالا | قیمت |
|---|---|
| چای | ۱۲۰٬۰۰۰ |
| قهوه | ۱۸۰٬۰۰۰ |
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_pdf_arabic with the table text and returns a link. The PDF has a right-to-left table with a bold header row and Persian digits in order.

positive.description: Broken Arabic copied out of a PDF is diagnosed and fixed.
positive.prompt: I copied this from a PDF and the letters look broken, can you fix it? ﻢﻜﺑ ﺎﺒﺣﺮﻣ
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_arabic_text. It reports pre-shaped glyph characters and reversed order, and returns fixed_text equal to the Arabic phrase meaning 'welcome to you', which the assistant shows to the user.

negative.description: Translation request: the tools do not translate, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into Arabic: Our office is closed on Friday.

negative.description: English-only document: no Arabic-script text, so make_pdf_arabic should not be called.
negative.prompt: Make a PDF of my English CV: John Smith, Software Engineer, 10 years of experience.

negative.description: Image request: the tools do not make images, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Create an image of Arabic calligraphy for my wall.

review.commerce_description: No commerce in ChatGPT. The plugin is free and shows no plans, prices, upgrade prompts or checkout links.
